question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Collapse
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (2)** i.e. **'Flourish'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Collapse : (ह्रास)** - To fall down or give way suddenly; to break down or fail.

 
 
• **Example:** The old building began to collapse after years of neglect.
 
 
 
• **Flourish : (फलना-फूलना)** - To grow or develop in a healthy or vigorous way; to thrive.
 
 
• **Example: **The garden began to flourish with colorful flowers in the spring.
 
 
 
• From the above example, it is clear that 'Flourish' is the antonym of 'Collapse'.

Therefore, the correct answer is 'Flourish'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Collaborate : (सहयोग करना) **- To work together with others, typically on a joint project or task.

 
 
• **Example:** The two companies decided to collaborate on a new research initiative.
 
 
 
• **Flounder : (डगमगाना) **- To struggle or move awkwardly, especially in water or mud; to have difficulty or be in confusion.
 
 
• **Example:** He started to flounder in the deep water, unable to swim properly.
 
 
 
• **Slip : (फिसलना)** - To slide or lose one's footing unexpectedly; a small mistake or error.
 
 
• **Example: **She felt her foot slip on the icy pavement during the winter storm.
 
 

57:T972,

The correct answer is Option (2).</
